title: Chapter 246: Cigarette Wounds
html:
No. 10 might be an acquaintance trying to help Chen Ge—or a psychiatric patient manipulating him into lowering his guard. To learn the truth, Chen Ge would have to visit the Linjiang New Schistosomiasis Control Station.

After making sure he did not miss anything, Chen Ge walked out of the room and returned to the elevator.

These locked rooms must conceal other secrets. The hidden exit may be behind one of them.Chen Ge regretted leaving the hammer behind; with it, he could have broken down every door. I’ll remember that next time.

Back inside the elevator, Chen Ge watched the numbers descend and finally breathed a sigh of relief. He strapped the cleaver to his calf, removed the mask, and inhaled deeply. When the car stopped on the first floor, a stern voice reached him before he stepped out.

“How did he get in here? I’m asking you, how did he get in here?!”

“Supervisor Huang, I really don’t know how he managed to sneak in here.”

“We have a murderer in our building, and you’re telling me you don’t know anything?!”

“I’m sorry.”

“I paid you to protect the tenants, not for you to apologize to me! How many troubles have happened recently? You can count for yourself!”

Chen Ge looked beyond the elevator. Zhu Xiu, whom he had hidden in a corner, was gone.

Where is the man?

He glanced toward the lobby. Gu Feiyu stood in uniform with his head lowered, phone in hand. Facing him was a refined-looking middle-aged man with a vicious temper.

“Xiao Gu? What’s going on?” Chen Ge walked over.

“Who are you?” The middle-aged man turned to Chen Ge. “You don’t look familiar. You’re not one of our tenants, are you?”

Then, he turned to glare at Gu Feiyu. “He’s your friend?”

Written rules prohibited admitting strangers after midnight. Knowing he had made another mistake, Gu Feiyu removed his cap and nodded.

“Supervisor Huang.” A police siren sounded outside, and a middle-aged man in casual clothes entered. “He is my friend.”

Chen Ge was shocked when he saw the man. “Inspector Lee?”

“I knew something was wrong when you left the station, but I didn’t expect you to flush this man out.” Inspector Lee pointed toward the entrance, where Zhu Xiu lay unconscious.

“You’ve been following me from the police station?” Chen Ge had not noticed that at all. Thinking back, he was scared.

“I’ve been a police officer for twenty years. If you had spotted me, it would be time to retire.” Inspector Lee turned to Supervisor Huang. “Don’t blame the kid. He did well tonight. The suspect is extremely cunning and has repeatedly evaded us. Even plainclothes officers failed to catch him, so a security guard cannot be faulted for missing him.”

“Even the police couldn’t catch him?” Supervisor Huang’s attitude transformed. He turned to Chen Ge and apologized at once. “So you’re also an officer? Thank you for your service.”

Chen Ge ignored him and looked at Inspector Lee with embarrassment. “You’ve been waiting outside the building?”

“What do you think? I watched you for an hour and a half at New Century Park, then followed you here. I’ve been waiting ever since.” Inspector Lee rolled his shoulders. “When you first came down with the suspect, I was ready to enter, but then you stepped back into the elevator.”

“Uncle Lee, do you know how dangerous that was?”

“Do you think I’d be here if I weren’t worried you might do something foolish?” Inspector Lee lowered his voice and pulled Chen Ge aside. “Zhu Xiu appears to have suffered severe trauma. Was he already like this when you found him?”

Something in Inspector Lee’s tone made Chen Ge study his expression. Understanding dawned. “Yes, he was already in this condition when I found him. I went back upstairs to investigate what happened.”

“Yes.” Inspector Lee nodded. “That does sound logical.”

Shortly after a police car took Zhu Xiu away, an ambulance arrived and stopped outside Building Three. Everyone exchanged puzzled looks. “Who called an ambulance?”

No one admitted to it. After a while, the number on the elevator moved before it stopped at the thirteenth floor.

“The tenants rarely use the elevator at night. Something must have happened.” Supervisor Huang and Gu Feiyu rushed toward it together. Moments later, the doors opened, and a middle-aged man emerged carrying an elderly woman.

“Doctor! Doctor!” The man’s mother appeared to have fainted from illness. Chen Ge paid little attention until he saw her face, and shock entered his eyes. She was the elderly woman who had waited outside the elevator on the thirteenth floor. Upon seeing the crowded car, she had complained,“Why are so many people taking the elevator so late at night? There isn’t even enough space for me.”

Her clothing was different now. Chen Ge could not tell whether he had seen the woman herself earlier—or her soul.

“Since she didn’t enter the elevator, she should survive.”

After the ambulance left, it was time for Chen Ge to go, but before that, he had something to do.

“Xiao Gu, how much are they paying you monthly to act as the night guard?”

“3,000.”

“You’re brave, and you have a good heart. If you ever decide to quit—or find yourself with nowhere else to go—come see me at New Century Park in Western Jiujiang.” Chen Ge pointed to his phone. “Call me first.”

Gu Feiyu looked rather interested. “Okay.”

After saying goodbye to Inspector Lee, Chen Ge hurried back to New Century Park. Home made him feel safer.

I feel more comfortable here.

He wrote down everything that required attention, committed the list to memory, then burned it.

Tomorrow will be a new day. After work, if there’s time, I should pay Linjiang New Schistosomiasis Control Station a visit.

It was getting late. Chen Ge fed the white cat and lay down to sleep, but as he did so, his phone rang.

Is this Inspector Lee?Chen Ge assumed something had happened to Zhu Xiu, but Captain Yan’s name appeared on the screen.

“Sorry for disturbing, Chen Ge, but I have something to confirm with you.”

Captain Yan sounded so polite that refusing would have been rude. “All right, but please be quick.”

“I’ve sent you the picture. Take a look at it. We saw this when we were looking over the surveillance around Hai Ming Apartments.”

Chen Ge opened the image. It was an enhanced still from surveillance footage.

A man in a jacket appeared to be speaking on the phone in his right hand. His left held a flyer for Chen Ge’s Haunted House. Cigarette burns and small wounds marked the back of that hand.

“Do you recognize the person in the picture?”
